fact: On 8 May 2025 Nigeria's NCC delegation met Ghana's NCA in Accra, where Ghana noted its ECOWAS free roaming agreements with Cote d'Ivoire, Togo and Benin and the NCC head said Nigeria was eager to collaborate on ECOWAS Roaming.
title: NCA and NCC Deepen Regulatory Collaboration During Bilateral Meeting in Accra
